- Initial release of restaurant and food delivery research skill using the Crawlora API.
- Supports searching and retrieving restaurant reviews (Yelp), reservations (OpenTable), and delivery menus (DoorDash, Uber Eats) via normalized JSON.
- Enables grocery product and store search through Instacart.
- Cleanly separates platform-specific search requirements, including necessary location parameters.
- Includes setup instructions, API endpoint usage examples, and practical use cases.
